description: Create MongoDB schema migrations and initialize core tournament, leaderboard, and player social collections. Set up Zod validation schemas and populate with seed data for testing.
steps: Create lib/flowternity/schemas.js with Zod schema definitions: Tournament, BracketMatch, Leaderboard, GameHistory, PlayerSocial, CommunityStats models matching design spec

Add database indexes to MongoDB: tournaments (sport_id, status, created_at), bracket_matches (tournament_id, round), leaderboards (sport_id, period, rank), player_social (user_id), game_history (user_id, game_id, date)
Create seed script at /scripts/seed-tournaments.js that populates: 5 tournaments with various statuses, 20 bracket matches across tournaments, sample leaderboard entries, community stats snapshot
Run seed script during development setup to verify collections created and data populated without errors
acceptance_criteria: MongoDB collections created: tournaments, bracket_matches, leaderboards, game_history, player_social, community_stats
Indexes created successfully with no errors
Seed script populates at least 5 tournaments and 20 matches
yarn dev starts without build errors
verification: Run seed script: node scripts/seed-tournaments.js (output: 'Seeding complete')
yarn dev starts successfully on port 3000
Check console: no errors during startup
